name: crayonbox
description: Image and video generation MCP server for any OpenAI-compatible provider: own base URL and key, models picked from /models.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible image/video API base, e.g. https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Provider key, sent as Bearer. Stored in secure storage.

image_model.title: Image model
image_model.description: Empty = auto-pick the best image model from the provider's /models list.

video_model.title: Video model
video_model.description: Empty = auto-pick the best video model from the provider's /models list.
